title: Confectionery Compat Recipes
description: Adds recipes to make Create: Confectionery compatible with other Create addons
body:
**This datapack adds, removes, and edits recipes to make Create: Confectionery compatible with Create: Ratatouille, Create: Dragons Plus, Create: Lowheated, & Create: Garnished Reworked.
Confectionery & Dragons Plus are required for this datapack to work, the others are optional.**

### Changes:

For most recipes, you will be able to use a Basic Burner rather than a Blaze Burner

For every chocolate producing recipe, there are two of changes you can make with the same result:
- You can replace Milk with Cocoa Butter and Cocoa Beans with Cocoa Solids
- You can replace Cocoa Beans / Cocoa Solids with Hazelnut
- You can also do both as well as lowheating these recipes

For Hot Chocolate, there is a new recipe using Water and Cocoa Butter instead of Milk.

Dried Cocoa Beans & Nibs from Create: Ratatouille are removed and Cocoa Liquor is instead made with Cocoa Beans. The Cocoa Butter & Cocoa Powder from Ratatouille are also replaced by the Cocoa Butter & Cocoa Powder from Create: Confectionery.

Ruby Chocolate is made with fluid Dragon's Breath from Create: Dragons Plus rather than Vanilla Minecraft's Dragon's Breath bottles. Create: Dragons Plus is required for this reason.

I have also changed the recipes for melting Chocolate Bricks Stairs to return 750mB rather than 1B since it's only 3/4 of a block.

I will not be adding a mod version as it seems that the mod doesn't replace recipes.
